name: Autocomplete station shows the misread broken twin

planSteps.description: Take the address of the page already open, keep everything before '#' exactly as it is, and open it with '#/letter/autocomplete' after it (for example .../#/letter/autocomplete). Do not go to any other site address. Wait 3 seconds
Verify the station heading is 'Autocomplete' and the state line ends with 'Misread.'
Verify the broken version's reading shows truth 'Should fail' and TestSprite's verdict 'Passed'
Verify the working version's reading shows truth 'Should pass' and verdict 'Passed'
